visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark, styled hair and a black pleated shirt sits at a wooden table in a brightly lit indoor studio. He looks directly at the camera, gesturing with his hands as he speaks. Behind him is a yellow sofa and a metal shelf with decorative items. (2) The scene cuts to stock footage of a woman sleeping peacefully on a white pillow in a dim bedroom, followed by another woman sleeping on her stomach. Text overlays and variety-show style graphics appear near the figures. (3) The video returns to the man at the table, who continues to explain concepts using expressive facial movements and hand motions. A 'thinking' cartoon emoji appears briefly near his head. (4) The man is now wearing a yellow, fuzzy Pikachu-themed onesie and is positioned on the yellow sofa. He holds and demonstrates a white pillow, pressing into it with his hands to show its texture. Close-ups of the pillow and graphic diagrams illustrating its internal layers and zones appear. He lies down in various positions—back, side, and hugging the pillow—to demonstrate comfort. He finally holds the packaged product toward the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice speaking at a brisk pace with high articulation clarity. The tone is informative and engaging. A bright, upbeat acoustic guitar-driven BGM starts immediately, featuring a steady 4/4 rhythm with light percussion. (2) A subtle digital 'shing' SFX triggers as text graphics appear on screen. The narrator's pitch variability increases as he discusses sleeping habits, using dramatic emphasis on certain words. The BGM remains at a consistent moderate volume under the speech. (3) A new phase is marked by a soft thudding sound as the narrator presses his hands into a pillow. The vocal delivery becomes more enthusiastic and persuasive as the focus shifts to product features. (4) Multiple quick 'whoosh' sounds and digital 'ding' sound effects punctuate the transitions between product benefit shots. The narrator maintains a high arousal level, sounding cheerful and confident. (5) The video concludes with the narrator delivering a call to action. The music maintains its energy, and the track ends with a clean fade-out of both the vocal and the background instrumental bed.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem Identification -> Educational Hook -> Solution (Product) -> Feature Breakdown -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote 3M's anti-mite washable memory pillows by first educating the audience on the pros and cons of various sleeping positions. It positions the product as a versatile solution that provides comfort and orthopedic support regardless of sleep style.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of 3M branded products, logos, and specific call to action to check the link in the info bar.
